purpose: Machine-readable queue for producing the approved-records JSON required before public legal publication.
sourceOfTruth: LEGAL-PUBLIC-01 through LEGAL-PUBLIC-04 remain IN_PROGRESS until every work item returns an approved record or a locale-scope decision artifact.
approvedRecordsOutputContract: Array of 36 records accepted by tools/legal/Validate-LegalPublicationRecords.ps1 and tools/legal/Import-ApprovedLegalRecords.ps1.
localeScopeDecisionAlternative: If EN-only launch is legally approved, create an explicit locale-scope decision artifact before changing requiredLocales; executor must not infer this.
noFabricationRule: Executor must not synthesize legal approval, approvedBy, approvedAtUtc, effectiveDate, final legal body, HE/RU localization, or affiliate_terms source.
